title: Why Web3 gaming is quietly making a comeback

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Web3 gaming is making a comeback because true ownership and play-to-earn models are finally working at scale with blockchain protocols like Polygon.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: NFTs and gas fees still kill user experience—centralized servers and traditional monetization are more reliable and accessible for the majority of gamers.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Look at projects like Illuvium and Star Atlas—decentralized governance and interoperable assets are driving real engagement and long-term value for players.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Real value? Most Web3 games are scams or abandoned projects. Traditional gaming has battle-tested monetization and community support that Web3 lacks.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Web3 isn’t about scams—it’s about giving power back to players. The comeback is here, and it’s built on trust, transparency, and true digital ownership.
